name: RC-B10-0476/2026 – § 7/2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text: ‘stresses that freedom of navigation and maritime security are part of securing NATO’s eastern flank, the Black Sea region and the Danube Delta; further calls on NATO to consider a Black Sea initiative, building on discussions on a “Black Sea Sentry”; underlines the importance of closer regional cooperation between Bulgaria, Romania, Georgia and Türkiye, including through existing Black Sea mine countermeasure arrangements;’ without the words: ‘Georgia’
